All host / two-way-transfer framing was reframed accordingly (a better fit for the multi-sensor EO methodology).

PRIOR-METHOD ATTRIBUTION: the synthetic concept attributed an 'uncertainty-aware AquaCrop calibration method (doi:10.1016/j.envsoft.2022.105556)' to the fellow. This attribution is REMOVED - that is not Dr. Cholakova's work. The AquaCrop / probabilistic-fusion methodology is retained as a project/literature method (operator-confirmed to keep); the fellow's real contribution is grounded in her non-destructive stress-physiology expertise (doi:10.2139/ssrn.5492527), which is the project's ground-truth/validation strength (RQ4).
coherence_note: RQ3 retains root-zone soil moisture in the target state while RQ4 grounds validation in plant-level non-destructive measures - which directly validate the crop-water-status component. The soil-moisture component is diagnosed but validated indirectly; adding in-situ soil-moisture probes, or narrowing RQ3 to crop water status, would fully close it. Recorded as an Inferred note; not a blocker.
